label.zh: 对先知说什么：取决于泽洛族故事线进度
label.en: What to tell the Far-Seer: depends on the Zroni storyline

note.zh: 3210 的前三个选项由探索者在泽洛族考古故事线中的进度决定（进入 3210 时由 update_zrony_storyline_flags 设为 completed / started / not_started 三者之一）：已完成 → 3215，已开始 → 3220，未开始 → 3225；非唯物主义者可选“无权干预”、唯物主义者可选“微不足道”（都 → 3230）。
note.en: The first three options of 3210 depend on the explorer's progress in the Zroni archaeology storyline (update_zrony_storyline_flags sets exactly one of completed / started / not_started): completed → 3215, started → 3220, not started → 3225; non-materialists may choose “not our place”, materialists “trivial” (both → 3230).

label.zh: 劝阻或鼓励先知进入虚境
label.en: Discourage or encourage the Far-Seer to enter the Shroud

note.en: 3215.a / 3220.a / 3225.a discourage (→ 3235), 3215.b / 3220.b / 3225.b encourage (→ 3240, 3215.b raises difficulty by 1). The two options of 3225 exclude fanatic spiritualists and fanatic materialists respectively.

note.zh: 不干预先知：大量星界丝缕、矿物与稀有水晶收入；探索结束。
note.en: Not intervening: a large astral thread reward, minerals and rare crystals income; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 探索结束：格式塔与唯物主义帝国获得能量，其他帝国获得一项灵能研究选项。数年后获得一项稀有科技选项与大量星界丝缕。
note.en: The exploration ends: gestalt and materialist empires gain energy, others a psionics research option. Some years later come a rare technology option and a large astral thread reward.

note.zh: 探索结束，奖励同前（能量或灵能研究）。数年后得“泽珞族洞见”（舰队太空风暴影响减半）、能量、稀有水晶与大量星界丝缕。
note.en: Exploration ends with the same energy or psionics reward. Years later: Zroni Insight (fleets take half space storm harm), energy, rare crystals and a large astral thread reward.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1，无条件；不产出遗珍，没有失败分支（00_astral_rifts.txt:422-431）。故事通过国家标记 zroni_intro / zroni_completed 与泽洛族考古故事线衔接，但并不属于该故事线，未并入。
notes.en: Draw weight 1, no conditions; no relic and no failure branch (00_astral_rifts.txt:422-431). The story ties into the Zroni archaeology storyline through the country flags zroni_intro / zroni_completed but is not part of it, and is not merged.

notes.zh: 3235 / 3240 的 a 选项立即结束探索；3280 / 3285 是之后很久才送达的国家事件（hidden_effect 内 days = 1080, random = 720），其正文随泽洛族故事线进度变化。
notes.en: Option a of 3235 / 3240 ends the exploration immediately; 3280 / 3285 are country events delivered much later (days = 1080, random = 720 inside a hidden_effect), their text varying with the Zroni storyline progress.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 3200–3292 全部事件、泽洛族故事线标记、延时事件和奖励。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 3200–3292 with the Zroni storyline flags, delayed events and rewards.

note.en: In the game, the name of this collective appears here.

note.en: In the game, the name of that empire appears here.
